title: Tôi có thể thanh toán cho tài xế bằng thẻ không?
englishTitle: Can I pay the driver by card?
pronunciation: Toi co the thanh toan cho tai xe bang the khong
summary: For checking whether a driver can take card payment before you get in, leave the airport, or finish the ride.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Ask before the luggage goes in or the ride starts. The answer may be card, cash, bank transfer, or app payment.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the card or payment screen if needed. Do not wait until the end of the ride if you have no cash.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Tôi có thể asks can I; thanh toán means pay; cho tài xế means the driver; bằng thẻ means by card; không makes it a yes/no question.

breakdown.vietnamese: Tôi có thể thanh toán cho tài xế bằng thẻ không?
breakdown.english: Can I pay the driver by card?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Cash, bank transfer, receipt, break this bill, and airport-fee cards cover the payment questions around a ride.

phrases.english: Where can I buy a SIM card?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at airport pickups, hotel-arranged cars, taxis, private drivers, and counters that assign a driver.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: A card terminal may belong to the company, not the driver. Confirm before the car leaves the pickup area.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Move to cash, bank-transfer, receipt, break-bill, or airport-fee cards if payment needs another option.
